name: Core Transitions
author: VidTSX
description: The built-in transitions: the everyday ones. More ship as VidTSX Transitions — Volume 01, an importable pack.

transitions.name: Push left
transitions.description: The next scene pushes the current scene off screen.

transitions.name: Wipe right
transitions.description: A crisp edge reveals the next scene from left to right.

transitions.name: Zoom through
transitions.description: Accelerate into the next scene with a soft scale dissolve.
transitions.usage: Travel, product details, and energetic cuts.

transitions.name: Iris open
transitions.description: A circular aperture opens from the center of the frame.
transitions.usage: Subject reveals and playful scene changes.
